chapters.title: Welcome to Data Analysis
chapters.description: Start your journey into the world of data! Understand what data analysis is, why it's important, and set up your tools.

chapters.title: Python Fundamentals: Variables & Data Types
chapters.description: Master the building blocks of Python – numbers, strings, booleans, and how to store them in variables.

chapters.title: Control Flow: Making Decisions & Loops
chapters.description: Teach your programs to think! Use conditions, loops, and functions to automate tasks.

chapters.title: Python Data Structures: Lists & Dictionaries
chapters.description: Organise your data efficiently with lists and dictionaries – the foundations of pandas.

chapters.title: Introduction to Pandas: Series & DataFrames
chapters.description: Meet the star of data analysis! Create, explore, and manipulate Pandas Series and DataFrames.

chapters.title: Data Cleaning with Pandas
chapters.description: Turn messy data into clean treasure. Handle missing values, duplicates, and outliers like a pro.

chapters.title: Data Transformation: Filtering, Sorting & Grouping
chapters.description: Slice and dice your data with powerful filtering, sorting, and aggregation techniques.

chapters.title: Data Visualization with Pandas
chapters.description: Bring your data to life! Create stunning line, bar, and scatter plots directly from DataFrames.

chapters.title: Relational Databases & SQL Basics
chapters.description: Step into the world of databases. Learn how data is stored and why SQL is the universal query language.

chapters.title: Querying Data with SELECT & Filtering
chapters.description: Write your first SQL queries! Retrieve exactly the data you need with SELECT, WHERE, and ORDER BY.

chapters.title: Advanced SQL: JOINs & Aggregations
chapters.description: Combine tables and compute powerful statistics using JOINs, GROUP BY, and aggregate functions.

chapters.title: Connecting Pandas and SQL
chapters.description: The ultimate duo! Execute SQL queries from Pandas, read/write databases, and combine their strengths.

chapters.title: Real-World Data Analysis Project
chapters.description: Apply everything you've learned to a complete, end-to-end data analysis project. Clean, query, visualise, and present!

chapters.title: Course Wrap-Up & Next Steps
chapters.description: Consolidate your skills, explore further learning paths, and become a confident data analyst.
